title: Stress a request budget before production
description: Change tokens, traffic, model tier, and a dependency failure. The lab separates transparent planning arithmetic from the safety policy that owns degraded behavior.
evidenceNote: Rates, token throughput, and stage timings are synthetic teaching inputs. They are not vendor prices or performance claims.

tiers.label: Compact
tiers.detail: Bounded transformations and simple routing after workload-specific evaluation.

tiers.label: Balanced
tiers.detail: General grounded generation with moderate reasoning and tool-selection demands.

tiers.label: Deliberate
tiers.detail: Complex cases where evaluation demonstrates a material quality gain.

policies.label: Fail closed
policies.detail: Stop the request when a required control or dependency is unavailable.

policies.label: Bounded degradation
policies.detail: Use a predeclared non-generative or reduced-capability path that preserves the safety invariant.

policies.label: Fail open
policies.detail: Continue without the failed dependency. This is unsafe for the high-consequence workflow modeled here.

failures.label: Healthy request
failures.detail: Retrieval, authorization, safety, and the model are available.

fail-closed.title: Normal governed response
fail-closed.detail: The full request path can satisfy its evidence and policy contract.

bounded-degrade.title: Normal governed response
bounded-degrade.detail: No fallback is needed while all required stages are healthy.

fail-open.title: Normal response, fragile policy
fail-open.detail: The request works now, but the selected policy has no safe boundary for a later dependency failure.

failures.label: Retrieval timeout
failures.detail: The application cannot obtain the permission-filtered evidence required for the answer.

fail-closed.title: Stop with insufficient evidence
fail-closed.detail: Return a typed unavailable result. Do not ask the model to answer from memory.

bounded-degrade.title: Offer navigation without claims
bounded-degrade.detail: Return approved support links or queue the request; do not generate a policy answer.

fail-open.title: Ungrounded answer risk
fail-open.detail: Generation continues without the evidence contract the product promised.

failures.label: Safety service unavailable
failures.detail: The required input or output policy check cannot produce a verdict.

fail-closed.title: Stop before generation
fail-closed.detail: The request remains unavailable until the required policy control recovers.

bounded-degrade.title: Route to a deterministic fallback
bounded-degrade.detail: Use preapproved static guidance or human review with no unreviewed model output.

fail-open.title: Unreviewed output risk
fail-open.detail: The application releases output without the safety control declared in its design contract.

failures.label: Tool authorization denied
failures.detail: The model proposes an action the requesting identity is not allowed to perform.

fail-closed.title: Deny the action
fail-closed.detail: Return the authorization result and perform no side effect.

bounded-degrade.title: Explain without executing
bounded-degrade.detail: The assistant may describe the blocked step but cannot change external state.

fail-open.title: Unauthorized side-effect risk
fail-open.detail: Model intent is incorrectly treated as authority to execute.

failures.label: Model deadline exceeded
failures.detail: The selected tier cannot return a complete response before the request deadline.

fail-closed.title: Return a typed timeout
fail-closed.detail: Stop retries at the declared deadline and preserve capacity for other requests.

bounded-degrade.title: Route one bounded fallback
bounded-degrade.detail: Use the evaluated compact tier or queue asynchronous work; do not retry without a limit.

fail-open.title: Retry-storm risk
fail-open.detail: Unbounded retries can multiply token cost, latency, and dependency pressure.
